name: findesk
description: Central pessoal de finanças e investimentos para Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.domain.json --noEmit && ngc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.lint: eslint src desktop shared domain fixtures tests scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:domain && node --test tests/security.test.mjs tests/domain/money.test.mjs tests/domain/dates.test.mjs tests/domain/finance.test.mjs tests/persistence/storage.test.mjs
scripts.test:domain: npm run build:domain && node --test tests/domain/money.test.mjs tests/domain/dates.test.mjs tests/domain/finance.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
